1運営者あたり最大3件。Bazaar の30日呼び出し数の多い順。Bazaar に無い運営者は x402 Endpoint のカタログから（エンドポイント単位の件数なし）。
全体で80件を超えたら、エンドポイントの呼び出し数（無ければ運営者の tx 数）の多い順に80件。

items.description: Takes an audio or video file by URL or inline base64 and returns the transcript: the full text, every word with start and end time and its own confidence, the utterances and paragraphs the recogniser separated, and the detected language with its confidence where no language was specified.

confidence_threshold.description: Words below this confidence are listed separately as the passages worth checking.

duration_minutes.description: Length of the recording in started minutes — this is what you are billed for. A longer file is refused with its real length and nothing is charged; a shorter one costs what you declared, and the answer says how much less it would have been.

include_words.description: Return every word with its timestamp. Off returns only the text, paragraphs and utterances.

language.description: BCP-47 code such as de, en, es. "multi" enables multilingual recognition and is billed at the provider's higher rate. Omit to let the recogniser detect the language.

source.description: The recording. Either url or content_base64.

content_base64.description: The file inline, base64. Larger files must come by url.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the audio or video file.

items.description: OpenAI-compatible chat API, many models incl. free ones. Pay per call in USDC on Base or Solana, no API key. Models: GET /v1/catalog.

messages.content: Where is good coffee near the Colosseum?

body.description: Listed price = ceiling for the example (max_tokens 400, list price); a larger max_tokens or longer prompt is quoted higher (max_tokens above 8192 counts as 8192); upto settles actual usage.

fallback_models.description: Optional on paid /v1/chat/completions only: 1–3 trimmed unique model ids, excluding the pinned model and singit/auto. Before payment, an unavailable pinned model may use the first healthy priced candidate whose Base upto maximum price is no higher than the pinned model's, and in the same auto tier if the pinned model has one. The chosen model determines the quote and usage charge.

max_tokens.description: Output token budget; values above 8192 are clamped. Invalid values default to 800.

messages.description: Conversation; at most 100000 characters-equivalent including tools and an estimated 8000 per image. Body limit 128 kb.

content.description: Null or omitted only for assistant tool_calls; tool messages accept strings or text blocks.

url.description: HTTPS URL or base64 image data URL; at most four images per request.

model.description: Any model id from GET /v1/models; the ceiling follows its price. Omit for the default model. Free to try, no payment: free/openai-gpt-oss-20b, free/gemma-4-e2b, free/gemma-3-27b-it, free/mistral-small-3.2-24b-instruct, free/qwen3-coder-30b-a3b-instruct, free/deepseek-v4.1-flash.

stream.description: Buffered SSE: the complete answer is released after settlement, not token by token.

tool_choice.description: Requires tools; a named function must appear in tools.

tools.description: Function tools available to the model; at most 64 definitions.

message.content: Around the Colosseum, try Caffè Propaganda on Via Claudia or Bar Martini for an espresso with a view.

billing.description: What was charged, in USDC micro-units, or the free answer allowance

remainingToday.description: Free answers left today for this network, limited by the network and whole-day answer counts; the shared cost budget may end free answers sooner

resetsAt.description: Next UTC midnight (ISO 8601) for the free answer allowance

usage.description: Token counts and the model's own cost in micro-USD (buyer_cost_micro)
